fields.System.Title: RPL-202 — Find a source location
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a replenishment operator, I want the system to choose where the stock comes from, so
that I make one trip rather than three and take the right batch.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a need, then candidate sources are bulk locations holding the product in
  • available status.
  • - Given candidates, then they are ordered FEFO for expiry-tracked products, FIFO
  • otherwise.
  • - Given a candidate that can cover the whole need alone, then it is preferred over
  • several partial sources.
  • - Given equally suitable candidates, then the nearest to the pick face is chosen.
  • - Given blocked, quarantined, or reserved stock, then it is excluded.
  • - Given no candidate at all, then no task is created — see
  • [RPL-205](RPL-205-alert-when-no-source.md).

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment, inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, batch, location |
| Risks | Breaking FEFO ([doc 09 §4.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); competing with allocation ([doc 09 §7.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
